plugins.name: GPX Viewer
plugins.description: Explore GPX tracks, routes and waypoints on an interactive map with timeline playback, elevation and speed charts.
plugins.compatibility: Requires Eidos Lite with Plugin API 3.0.0 or later, WebGL and browser workers. Read-only GPX file View; online basemap uses OpenFreeMap. Not supported by CLI Serve. Android and iOS are unverified.

screenshots.alt: GPX map and timeline showing a generated example route.
Synthetic GPX route details with elevation and speed charts.

plugins.name: Smart Actions
plugins.description: Use Jev to classify requests, assess urgency and score feedback, then write results to your table.
plugins.compatibility: Requires Eidos Lite 0.20.0 or later with Plugin API 3.0.0. Not supported by CLI Serve.

plugins.name: Map
plugins.description: Explore table records on a MapLibre map using latitude and longitude fields.
plugins.compatibility: Requires Eidos Lite 0.20.0 or Eidos CLI 3.0.0 or later with Plugin API 3.0.0.

plugins.name: Markmap
plugins.description: Visualize Markdown documents as interactive mindmaps.
plugins.compatibility: Requires Eidos Lite 0.20.0 or later with Plugin API 3.0.0. Not supported by CLI Serve.

plugins.name: Chart
plugins.description: Visualize table records with column, bar, line, and donut charts.
plugins.compatibility: Requires Eidos Lite 0.20.0 or Eidos CLI 3.0.0 or later with Plugin API 3.0.0. Native PNG export and embedded Dashboard presentation require Lite 0.22.1.

plugins.name: Dashboard
plugins.description: Arrange saved views and ordinary files into dashboards with draggable, resizable panels.
plugins.compatibility: Requires Eidos Lite 0.22.1 with Plugin API 3.2.0. Reads workspace files and edits .dashboard configuration files. Not supported by CLI Serve, Android or iOS.

plugins.name: Journals
plugins.description: Open or create today's Markdown journal with a yearly writing heatmap, streaks, and recent entries overview.
plugins.compatibility: Requires Eidos Lite 0.20.0 or later with Plugin API 3.0.0. Android requires a build with plugin Page navigation support. Not supported by CLI Serve.

plugins.name: Forest
plugins.description: A standalone warm paper light palette and deep forest dark palette for Eidos Lite.
plugins.compatibility: Requires Eidos Lite 0.18.0 or later with Plugin API 1.6.0. Not supported by CLI Serve.

plugins.name: Maple Mono
plugins.description: A standalone theme with bundled Maple Mono fonts and warm maple light and dark palettes.
plugins.compatibility: Requires Eidos Lite 0.18.0 or later with Plugin API 1.6.0. Not supported by CLI Serve.
